title: The Inventory Value PDF download shows the same net figures as the screen
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two tracked parts for this test at a cost of $10.00: part A with 5 in bin location A and 0 in bin location B, and part B with 0 in its only bin, so part A has two bins to add up.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line from bin location B while it holds 0, and 2 of part B while its bin holds 0, so part A's net is 3 and part B's is -2.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Use a computer that can open a PDF file.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.
custom_steps:
1. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the report's Search box.
  3. Click the three-dot menu of the report.
  4. Click Download (PDF).
  5. Open the downloaded PDF file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 2:

  • Part A shows Qty 3.00 and Total Cost $30.00; part B shows Qty -2.00 and Total Cost -$20.00.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers Download (PDF) and Download (CSV).

Step 4:

  • A PDF file downloads.

Step 5:

  • The PDF's row for part A shows quantity 3 and total cost $30.00, and its row for part B quantity -2 and total cost -$20.00: the same net figures as the screen.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; ships with this epic)

  • Feature Overview, Accounting: “Inventory Value figures already saved for past dates keep their saved values. The count of bins below zero, which ships with this release, applies from release on and does not rework earlier dates.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10380, description, Acceptance criteria: “Report rows, aggregate totals, exports and newly captured snapshots use the same net quantity basis for the same scope and cutoff. Quantity-dependent displayed values use that same basis.”
